**What this changes, and why:**

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` passes
- [ ] Standard library only, Python 3.11+
- [ ] If it changes a screen: checked at 80x25 as well as a wide window, in a browser and over telnet
- [ ] Plain words on screen (requests, not callers)
